steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Greetings, Madam Droste... What are you reading there?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: A wayside poetry anthology, Mr. McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Ah... you've always been keen on the like.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I still remember my first time seeing you, stood in that blood-soaked arena with the stench of iron, carrying a book like this too. Your surroundings were every bit out of place with you.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: You recall the details quite vividly, it seems...?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Ah... haha, ashamed as I am to admit, I'm one of your fans too. If you're not busy, I must have you sign something.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: It would be my greatest honor.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Excuse me, Mr. McKee.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: I'll leave the wine you requested right here.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Thank you. Send my regards to the other staff.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Let's take a moment to celebrate, Madam Droste.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I would be dearly happy to.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: A toast!

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: A toast.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: *sigh* Truly, a fine wine. It's a coveted Gaulish bottling, and its value would boggle any mind. A worthy tipple for a day such as today...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: And for a knight such as you.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: You flatter me. I've simply been of good fortune.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: This poetry anthology...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Authored by a poet of little name from my hometown. I very much adore the verses he pens.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Ah, a Leithanian anthology... the title means 'Twin Moons and Marigold'?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Your Leithanian is superb as ever.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Haha, it was simply necessary to learn for diplomacy. I'm guessing you like marigolds? We've very few Kazimierzians nowadays who know how to appreciate poetry.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: In the end, the letter can't break free of our mind's eye. These are all but marks for imaginations.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: To the contemporary man, poetry is no more than warrens of words lacking aesthetics, too self-assuming, too pretentious.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Perhaps Kazimierzians are accustomed to a different sort of consumption now, a kind poetry could never match. It's a very typical course of things.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Might you be... insinuating?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I'm merely discussing poetry, Mr. McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Don't you have something else you'd like to talk to us about, Madam?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Oh... I wonder what.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Ah. Your new glasses suit you very well.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Haha... w-well, it's sharp of you to notice such things. What a surprise, haha...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: *ahem* However, that's not quite relevant to you. No, there's been some prior rumors going around the intercity net and print presses...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Ah... The red wine baths?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Yes, it's been slandering your reputation...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Do people really bathe in red wine? Wouldn't it stick to them so?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Excuse me? I assume... I'm not sure.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: *sigh*... And who would believe such news?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Some would, Madam Droste... many would believe it. Sure as they know it may not be the truth, they'll still let the information color them.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Could we not clear the air?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Ah, you always do take non-knightly matters too lightly...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I've gotten in touch with the Rose Paper Union HQ; it turned out to be some entertainment editor's doing.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: It seems it had already drawn considerable attention by the time it was noticed, and with all the factors at play, no retraction came...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: This is the way they work. I give them no mind.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You're very forgiving, but that strengthens my feeling you've been wronged.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You've donated practically all your income to the poor of Leithanien, to build schools back home, to set up nomadic platforms.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But even if you deny the rumors now, the masses know the taste of delirium already, and they won't care what the truth is.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Hurting and slandering are simple things. They'll grab hold of the rumors and spread the news.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: And how many times have you seen, after the truth came out, those who'd worked against you turned to help you wash away the lies, to make the facts clear?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Gossip can be fresh and exciting to people, while the truth is an all too boring thing. By all rights, this is how it is.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: *sigh* How are you so unconcerned?!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Others should see an example in an upstanding, honorable knight like you! This ought to be better for your reputation, and besides—

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Erk...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I'm touched.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: You're all too thoughtful a person... and all too tender.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: As a Chamber spokesman, ensuring no external factors are of disturbance to any knight is part of my duty.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: That said, I'd like you to care more, please, about what happens to you.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Oh, I have a question for you.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: When will we have the competition schedule?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: *sigh*... How can not even your own matches concern you?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Provided nothing happens, your next opponent will be Graybeard Knight, followed by... the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Are you that shocked, Madam?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Of course. The Radiant Knight, Margaret Nearl... I've heard this name many, many times. Such beauty, firmness, and grace too.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Chamber wishes you victory.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Mm... and yet...

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: A 'Candle' to the 'Radiant.' What chance do I have of winning?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Don't be like that. Knight titles nowadays are more for catchiness than anything else. They've got nothing to do with true power, Madam Droste.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You're very strong.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Oh—I've won!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Dammit! You cheater!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Ahahah, ol' V's still top of his game~♪ You're the big fat loser tonight, Kowal~♪

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You belched on purpose calling 'start,' didn't you?!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Put the stool down, Kowal, that one's not built good. Get another one.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I win, Kowal~♪ You big fat loser~♪

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What did I walk in on?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Arm wrestling. What are you carrying there?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Some medicine I just picked up...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oh, for Młynar?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But he'll turn me the other cheek, I know that. Besides, I don't even think he'll start taking it on time...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: They couldn't be more different, personality-wise. But there are some areas where he and the sisters are very much alike.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I heard him and Margaret had a real, proper duel once. Margaret won.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Who knows, maybe that's how you wake Młynar up some.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Pfeh, I don't reckon that boy's got anything to wake up to. He's awake as can be. Too awake, he is. That's what turned him so funny these days.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Oh, Młynar...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...No, never mind.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hi, everyone! Oh, Zofia's here too.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria? What are you doing here alone?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Someone came looking for Margaret just now, so I came over ahead of her.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: There aren't a lot of cases where someone's been exiled and then allowed to return as a full citizen. They need to check over so many legal documents...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Funny, that. Their bunch went to hell and back to catch Margaret out, and now they welcome her back with open arms?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Plotting something, aren't they?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's what was haunting me before. Can't you two talk something nice for once?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: We're just worried, you know...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: If things really do go belly-up, we'll pack our bags and leave Kazimierz, head to that... Drohes Island whatsit to take a looksee.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Rhodes. Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria, how's your uncle?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah... I think Uncle Młynar's still at work. His shift might be over soon?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight gave that boy a harsh talking-to, didn't she?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hah, been a long time coming. If Old Man Nearl was still around, he wouldn't have stood for Młynar letting himself go like this—

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Maria?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: My sister could only make her return to the field because Młynar lost that duel. He's not going to have much more to say now.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oho. So Młynar knows when to admit defeat, then?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But—But when they dueled, he didn't even use the slightest bit of Arts until the end...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What? Was he throwing that one?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Scared to go all out, gave himself an excuse for losing? That's my sad reckoning.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Of course not. Admitting defeat, throwing? What makes you think he'd do something like that?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: He... he just can't stand Margaret. He can't stand the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: He didn't deem her worthy of using his full Arts, pure and simple. Nothing else.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: 'Ashlock' Greynuty, have you seen Sona?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: She's right over there... Why is my name the only one you put the title on?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...I can stop.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: If you don't like it... I just felt—it's the impression you gave me.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Whatever.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Whaaat—?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Come on! Everyone's here!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Hup—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Alright, alright. Are you all better now?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: My wounds won't get in the way... What's that? A figurine?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahaha, I'm a girl of my own, right? Is it so wrong to like cute things?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Okay, I get it. No leeway for jokes right now.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: 'Industrial accidents' are on the rise. They're herding the Infected about, terrorizing them and the slums alike.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Seeing as the Armorless Union's dropped all pretenses, hiding away's not an option anymore.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Szewczyk gave us some very interesting information. We need to hurry and—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: —Sona?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You seem kind of distracted.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If one day... we win our freedom...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...what would you like to do then?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it. We'll think about it together.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What's with you today...? Why so melancholy all of a sudden?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahaha, nothing. C'mon, hop to it.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Let's go meet Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub's new members.

steps.name: A Weathered Knight
steps.text: Seems it's nearly all Infected here.

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: The National Council could be watching, right?

steps.name: A Weathered Knight
steps.text: The Council don't hide when they're watching, and in the worst case, we just throw some money around. Money's the key to getting the law on your side.

steps.name: A Weathered Knight
steps.text: But if this keeps up... will the Armorless Union stand by and let it happen?

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: The Armorless Union? Do they even really exist?

steps.name: A Weathered Knight
steps.text: Best not doubt them. You'll be wiser for it.

steps.name: A Weathered Knight
steps.text: Oh, look over there, the ones coming over. They must be the Pinus Sylvestris knights.

steps.name: A Weathered Knight
steps.text: Huh. They look like a bunch of kids, at a glance.

steps.name: A Weathered Knight
steps.text: But... maybe some things, only the young can do.

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: 'Flametail' Sona.

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: 'Ashlock' Greynuty.

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: 'Fartooth' Justyna.

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Loud beeping noises)

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: Huh. I thought they had another one, a Kuranta...?

steps.name: A Weathered Knight
steps.text: Are we going to even make it through alive, if we jump on board with these kids' plans? And if we do, what then? What about next month? Next year?

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: There's something Infected often say, my friend. It all depends on you.

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: We've got Oripathy. Plenty choose to resign themselves to that... our lives will be short, and they could end at any moment.

steps.name: A Hoarse Knight
steps.text: But at the same time, my thinking is that's no guarantee we'll die tomorrow. As long as we've got so many 'tomorrows' lined up in front of us, we should damn well be taking them, fangs out.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Our numbers are dropping.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: We won't be able to save the Infected like this, Sona.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I know. That's why we need to find an opening, ASAP.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Hmph... Where's a couple of Infected-turned-knights' wealth and privilege going to get you in this city?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: All the money you spend on charity for these Infected, all the meaningless work to conceal them, dragging out their miserable lives in shacks and gutters.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: The city itself let you have all of this. You've got nothing close to an opening.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahaha, that's real hurtful to hear, Plastic Knight, sir.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What about your family, then, Szewczyk? Didn't the knight nobles win all those entrepreneurs over for you, heart and soul?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: With the General Chamber of Commerce targeting you, you're no different from us. Take a long, hard look at yourself.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: ...Keh... fair enough, we're all trash smashed down to the dirt here. No real difference at all.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Your name was Greynuty? The knight nobility have been doomed since the moment all those years ago when the Affinity was established.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Don't tell me you hold onto any delusions about your old clan, little squirrel.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (Did you think he'd go for an argument with you?)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You're calmer than I expected.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Keh. You know what, I'm dying to get out of this place. Heaven knows when you're going to pass that Oripathy around—

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: But seeing how you're not going to die for the next while, let's focus our attention on other matters—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The Armorless Union.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: The Chamber's scumbag lackeys. I'll give them something to regret.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: On that note, you're all so willing to face off with the Armorless... so you must have some ace up your sleeve, right?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: ...Area 0.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Or in other words, the Grand Knight Territory's Infected assembly and treatment section. A place for Infected healthcare, formed by an alliance of several companies.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Aren't you Infected knights regulars in those parts? So you tell me. What secrets are the Armorless Union hiding there?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: —Slow down, Szewczyk.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Of course we've got methods... but that doesn't mean we'll tell you about them just like that.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: If that's what you really thought, Infected, you would've left me in that wretched hospital and waited for the Armorless to come torture me for answers—you wouldn't have busted me out of there.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Don't you talk at me like this. We're only here now because we all did what we had to. Would your status alone give you the standing to address me, Ashlock?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Or do you think your busting me out means I should be weeping over you with gratitude?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You arrogant noble—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Uh—alright, alright, I'm not against you two fighting it out here and now. Better right this moment than a stab in the back after the Armorless Union shows up, anyway—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: —We've been doing this for a few years now, for better or worse... we have ins with some government channels.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: There's the impoverished and Infected who can't even get by day-to-day, but do you know who else in Kazimierz hates the General Chamber of Commerce?

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: ...Keh.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Either I've gone mad, or Kazimierz has. You couldn't be telling me a ragtag group of Infected are in deals with the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi to take down the K.G.C.C.?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ahaha...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Look at where you are in life. Look at the knights, Szewczyk.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: —They went mad forever ago.
